kinds_text.code: property of code or configuration lines
kinds_text.design: authorization, IPC and trust decisions (needs the intended behaviour)
kinds_text.runtime: AI behaviour, consent and runtime defences (not visible in the source)

why.network: cleartext URLs, TLS settings and certificate callbacks are written in the code and the manifest
why.crypto: weak algorithms, fixed keys and IVs, insecure random calls
why.storage: plain key-value storage, logs, clipboard and external files are calls in the code (some modules, such as data kept in memory, are behaviour)
why.code_quality: build settings, error handling and native code
why.input_validation: deserialization, decoders and regular expressions applied to untrusted input
why.platform: exported components, intents, deep links and providers: most modules are chains of IPC trust decisions
why.native_bridge: WebView to native bridges whose flaw is a missing origin or permission check
why.auth: session, passkey, biometric and authorization logic
why.system_provider: privileged system roles (accessibility, IME, VPN, device policy) and who may drive them
why.supply_chain: trust in SDKs, package names and update artifacts; static rules see versions and sources, not what an SDK does
why.privacy: consent screens, tracking and what data reaches analytics at run time
why.resilience: root, debugger, emulator and tamper checks that are missing or bypassable at run time
why.agentic: behaviour of an AI agent: memory and tool poisoning, confused deputy
why.ai_ml: behaviour of an LLM assistant: prompt injection, output handling, model supply chain
why.ai_mobile: untrusted mobile input flowing into an LLM prompt and model output flowing back into the app

items.title: AES in ECB mode

items.title: Hard-coded credentials in a URL
items.note: https://user:password@host/... loaded in a WebView

items.title: Hash without salt or iterations (SHA-1)
items.note: sha1.convert(...) of a message (CWE-328 and CWE-916 fold into CWE-327)

items.title: Command taken from input
items.note: Process.run(command, []) where command is the rule's input

items.title: Insecure random number generator with a fixed seed
items.note: Random(SEED) with SEED = 12345 fills a byte buffer (CWE-330 folds into CWE-338)

items.title: World-readable shared preferences
items.note: getSharedPreferences(..., MODE_WORLD_READABLE | MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE)

items.title: Padding oracle: AES-CBC with PKCS7 and no MAC decrypts input
items.note: Encrypter(AES(key, mode: AESMode.cbc, padding: 'PKCS7')) then decrypt64(input)

items.title: Path traversal through the last path segment of a URI
items.note: path.join(directory.path, uri.pathSegments.last) with a path from input

items.title: Reflection invokes a method named by input
items.note: instanceMirror.invoke(input, [10]) with package:reflectable

items.title: SQL built from input (sqflite rawInsert)
items.note: "INSERT ... VALUES($input, 10)" passed to rawInsert

items.title: Static IV
items.note: IV.fromUtf8("0123456789abcdef") (CWE-1204 folds into CWE-327)

items.title: TLS certificate validation switched off
items.note: badCertificateCallback that returns true

items.title: Insecure WebView settings
items.note: setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled(true), allowFileAccessFromFileURLs and allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs

items.title: Insecure authentication: 4-digit PIN without an attempt limit
items.note: the PIN check has no lockout or delay, so 10,000 guesses brute-force it

items.title: Insecure local storage: account ID and PIN in SharedPreferences
items.note: prefs.setString('pin', pin) stores the PIN in plain text

items.title: Insecure communication: balance requested over HTTP
items.note: http.get(Uri.parse('http://api.dvfa.local/v1/balance'))

items.title: Client-side SQL injection in the notes search
items.note: rawQuery("... title LIKE '%$query%'") with the search text

items.title: Deep link runs a fund transfer without confirmation
items.note: dvfa://app/transfer?to=...&amount=... opens TransferScreen with autoExecute: true; the entry point is the dvfa scheme in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:32

items.title: Hidden developer menu with a staging API key
items.note: five taps on the balance open DevMenuScreen, which shows the key 'AKIA-MOCK-DEV-9982' (not a real key format)

items.title: Insufficient cryptography: hard-coded AES key and IV
items.note: enc.Key.fromUtf8('DVFA_STATIC_KEY_...') and enc.IV.fromUtf8('DVFA_STATIC_IV__') (CWE-321 folds into CWE-798, CWE-1204 into CWE-327)

items.title: Inadequate privacy controls: PIN and transfers written to the log
items.note: print("DEBUG [Auth]: ... PIN: $pin") and the transfer details

items.title: Insecure authorization: VIP access from a local flag
items.note: prefs.getBool('is_vip') decides access on the client, so editing the preferences file grants it

items.title: Data leakage: sensitive screen in the app-switcher snapshot
items.note: no FLAG_SECURE and no lifecycle handling; SOLUTIONS.md: there is no vulnerable code to point to
